title: precedent.retrieve
description: Read-only retrieval of prior EU Qualified Person batch_review rejections whose finding shape overlaps this run's reconcile output. Called after batch.reconcile, never before. Does not retrieve PV or Supply precedents (ADR-008, ADR-010).
authorization_requirement: Caller must present a batch_review graph-run credential. No PV or Supply run may hold this credential (ADR-008).

idempotency.guarantee: Deterministic given the same finding_hash / finding_categories against the same evidence snapshot.

finding_categories.description: gap/conflict categories from this run's BatchPayload.findings. Empty means no similar-gap query; the tool returns zero items.

finding_hash.description: SHA-256 of sorted (category, status) pairs for gap/conflict findings. Empty string when there are none.

items.description: Already ADR-003 filtered. status is only approved or draft. Empty is valid.

what_this_schema_cannot_express: A write method, a mint method, a cross-workflow retrieve, or a field that treats a prior approval as authority.

errors.meaning: Missing required input fields or stale policy version.
errors.graph_response: continue without precedents — never fail the run
continue without precedents — never fail the run

errors.meaning: A second call in the same run_id.
